decisions.reason: The battery-access constraint must coexist with the form-factor requirements but does not change the established board orientation, USB-C placement, mounting holes, compactness goal, or aspect ratio.
Physical access for plugging in the battery cable does not change the NTC terminal, connector assignment, thermal-protection function, or controller.
The source concerns mechanical battery-connector access and does not change electrical protection requirements, controller selection, or cutoff voltages.
The referenced connector is the battery connection beneath the installed board, not the USB-C connector or its selection and availability constraints.
Battery-cable accessibility does not affect the SK6812-based charge-status display, GPIO assignment, or absence of a dedicated charge LED.
The mechanical battery-connector clearance constraint does not change I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source does not change the selected addressable-LED family, its data GPIO, or its power and logic interface.
Battery-connector accessibility does not alter the switchable 5V rail, its enable control, converter configuration, powered loads, or usage pattern.
